title: Discourse and argument
summary: Order, add, contrast and prove points with *öncelikle*, *üstelik*, *kaldı ki*, *aksine*, *nitekim* and *zira*, conclude with *sonuç olarak* and *kısacası*, soften a claim with *bana kalırsa* and *kanımca*, tell a discovery with *meğer … -mIş*, and hold a written text together with *söz konusu* and *adı geçen*.
canDo: Build a spoken or written argument with markers that order, add, contrast and prove points
Close an argument and draw a conclusion in the right register
Give an opinion with the right amount of caution, in speech and in writing
Tell what you found out had been true all along with meğer … -mIş
Refer back to people, works and points in a formal text without repeating them
